language.label: Language
language.description: The console's own language. It is remembered in this browser and does not change what anyone else sees.

ai.heading: Language model
ai.subheading: The assistant speaks one protocol, so any endpoint that answers an OpenAI-shaped chat completion can serve it.

provider.label: Provider
provider.description: Choosing one fills in its endpoint and gives the model a default. Custom asks for both, and works with anything that answers an OpenAI-shaped chat completion.

base_url.label: Base URL
base_url.description: Where completions are asked for. Anything that answers an OpenAI-shaped POST /chat/completions works here — a gateway, a self-hosted server, or a provider's own endpoint. Leave it empty for OpenAI.

model.label: Model
model.hint_empty: Fetch the list from the endpoint above, or type a name. Empty uses the provider's default.
model.hint_loaded: {{count}} models. Start typing to filter, or leave it empty for the provider's default.
model.error_none: The endpoint answered, but listed no models.
model.error_key: The endpoint rejected the API key.
model.error_not_found: No model list at that URL. It usually needs the version segment, as in /v1.
model.error_unreachable: The endpoint could not be reached.

api_key.label: API key
api_key.description: Sent as a bearer token to the base URL above.

ai.not_listed: Not listed above? Choose Custom and give it the base URL — anything OpenAI-shaped will do.

telemetry.label: Telemetry
telemetry.description: Let Pace collect anonymous usage data

images.heading: Third-party image libraries
images.subheading: Let your users search and choose images from third-party libraries

email.heading: Secure emails from your own instance
email.subheading: Misconfigs can lead to email bounces and errors.
email.disable_error_message: Failed to disable email feature. Please try again.

auth.heading: Manage authentication modes for your instance
auth.allow_signup: Allow anyone to sign up even without an invite
